svg.aria-label: Two same-spin fermions in one-dimensional oscillator orbitals. Swapping coordinates reverses the wavefunction sign and leaves probability unchanged. The diagonal is zero.
svg.title: Two same-spin fermions in one-dimensional oscillator orbitals. Swapping coordinates reverses the wavefunction sign and leaves probability unchanged. The diagonal is zero.

g.text: Exchange reverses amplitude sign; the probability remains symmetric.
